title: AI led services to generate up to $200 billion in new work by 2030: BCG report
hook_text: Two hundred billion dollars in new AI work
script:
Two hundred billion dollars in new work is coming by two thousand thirty.
Boston Consulting Group authored this new study on expanding market demand.
The forecast tracks the rapid commercial expansion of automated business solutions.
Companies are restructuring corporate workflows to capture emerging revenue streams.
Consultancies project massive spending shifts toward digital transformation initiatives globally.
Will your enterprise secure a share of this expanding sector?
